banner.title: THE RT SEAM FIX - regtest.cpp file patches ride the in-memory engine text; the seam upgrades the engine through the ritual itself
banner.provenance: The R774 seam read every file patch target from disk. regtest.cpp is the one target the engine also patches in memory (the include and the audit block, writes deferred to the end), so the R776 site round - whose R403 charge flips are regtest file patches - would have clobbered them with the pristine disk copy. The fix is a file patch on tools/splice_engine.py: when the target is RT, the patch reads the in-memory text instead. The patch lands through the ritual, closing the R774 bootstrap note: the running old engine applies it to its own source on disk, the second run of the double-run executes the new engine, and ./rn git-adds the tool via the spec the usual way. The mount site itself is R776.
banner.sentinel: No book pages this round either: the provenance is the clobber class the site design exposed.
